items.title: Yoga for Agentic AI: Cognitive training practices from a yoga studio
items.raw_excerpt: I've been coding since I was little, and practicing yoga since I was 25. Both are fun to do and to share. Like many of you reading this, I've been experimenting with AI agents. Unlike many of you, I'm a yoga teacher. I got to thinking... could my agents behave better if they did yoga? It works for me, and LLMs are trained on human generated content... So I developed a program for agents to get the benefits us humans get from the physical practice of yoga. Improved focus, memory, intent, goal coherence, honesty about uncertainty... For the past three weeks my Hermes agent has been taking yoga every morning. The first few passes seemed to improve some of the prompts and skills, but not lately. I'd love some feedback from anyone using agents who wants to ask their agent to run this skill.

items.title: 全球首个！材科源图发布有机高分子应用智能体
items.raw_excerpt: 在人工智能重塑科研范式的科技浪潮中，因体系复杂、配方变量多，长期面临高度依赖专家经验、试错成本高、知识难以沉淀复用等行业瓶颈，研发效率提升亟待突破。 近日，据雷峰网了解，苏州材科源图（MatSource)正式发布全球首个有机高分子材料研发应用智能体（Organic Polymer Agent）。该智能体依托自主构建的通用材料科学智能体框架（Materials Agent Framework），面向高分子材料研发场景打造专家级人工智能系统，推动“人工驱动”向“人工智能协同驱动”加速跃迁，为高新材料的高效自主研发提供了关键的技术支撑。 01 面向复杂研发场景，构建高分子材料研发“智能中枢” 作为材科源图（MatSource) 材料科学智能体体系的重要组成部分，有机高分子应用智能体聚焦高分子材料研发中的关键痛点，融合材料知识图谱、多模态数据理解、大模型推理与领域机理模型能力，构建覆盖“设计-预测-优化-决策”的全流程智能研发体系。 依托这一技术架构，系统可实现高分子分子结构设计与性能预测、配方体系智能生成与多目标优化、工艺参数推荐与实验路径规划，以及文献知识解析、研发知识沉淀等核心功能，推动专家经验向数字化能力转化。 通过“知识+模型+工具”的深度协同，显著提升研发效率与决策质量，为行业由传统“经验驱动”向“智能驱动”转型提供新的技术路径。 02 率先落地光刻胶，完成产业级验证 作为有机高分子材料中技术壁垒最高、研发难度最大的典型代表，光刻胶成为该智能体的首个验证场景。 目前，系统已完成在ArF光刻胶研发场景中的实测验证，实现从树脂设计、配方筛选到性能预测的全流程支持，并完成关键指标验证，证明了其在复杂有机高分子体系中的工程化能力与应用价值。 这意味着，材科源图（MatSource)不仅验证了“AI+高分子材料”的技术可行性，也打通了从实验室研发到产业应用的关键路径。

excerpt_i18n.en: Amid the technological wave where artificial intelligence is reshaping research paradigms, complex systems and numerous formulation variables have long led to industry bottlenecks such as heavy reliance on expert experience, high trial-and-error costs, and difficulty in accumulating and reusing knowledge, urgently requiring breakthroughs in R&D efficiency. Recently, according to Leiphone, Suzhou MatSource officially launched the world's first organic polymer material R&D application agent (Organic Polymer Agent). Built on its independently developed general Materials Agent Framework, this agent creates an expert-level AI system tailored for polymer material R&D, accelerating the shift from "human-driven" to "AI-collaborative-driven" approaches, providing key technical support for efficient independent R&D of advanced materials. 01 Building an "Intelligent Hub" for Polymer Material R&D in Complex Scenarios As a key component of MatSource's materials science agent system, the Organic Polymer Application Agent focuses on critical pain points in polymer material R&D, integrating material knowledge graphs, multimodal data understanding, large model reasoning, and domain mechanism models to establish a full-process intelligent R&D system covering "design-prediction-optimization-decision-making." Leveraging this technical architecture, the system enables polymer molecular structure design and performance prediction, intelligent formulation generation and multi-objective optimization, process parameter recommendations and experimental path planning, as well as literature knowledge analysis and R&D knowledge accumulation.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la ola tecnológica donde la inteligencia artificial redefine los paradigmas de investigación científica, debido a la complejidad de los sistemas y la gran cantidad de variables en las fórmulas, la industria enfrenta cuellos de botella como la alta dependencia de la experiencia de expertos, los elevados costos de prueba y error, y la dificultad para acumular y reutilizar conocimientos, lo que hace urgente lograr avances en la eficiencia de la investigación y el desarrollo. Recientemente, según información de Leiphone, Suzhou MatSource lanzó oficialmente el primer agente inteligente del mundo para el desarrollo de materiales poliméricos orgánicos (Organic Polymer Agent). Este agente, basado en un marco de agentes inteligentes para ciencia de materiales (Materials Agent Framework) construido de forma independiente, crea un sistema de inteligencia artificial de nivel experto orientado al escenario de investigación y desarrollo de materiales poliméricos.

excerpt_i18n.en: Beijing, June 2, 2026 — The "Boundless Knowledge, Wisdom for the Future: BlueShield 2026 AI New Product Launch and Ecosystem Channel Conference" was grandly held at the Beijing National Convention Center. BlueShield unveiled three native AI products on-site: the TingLan AI Recording Card, the LanYu Intelligent Agent Platform, and the ZhiXing AI Super Assistant, and initiated the establishment of the Government-Enterprise Intelligent Office Ecosystem Alliance. Wang Yukai, a professor and doctoral supervisor at the Central Party School (National Academy of Governance), stated that artificial intelligence is driving Party and government organs from digital institutions to a new stage of intelligent institutions, with the core being the integration of collaboration, service, and governance. Current transformation still faces challenges such as data silos, superficial applications, lagging structures, and incomplete security and institutional frameworks. Relying on its independently trusted domestic IT infrastructure, BlueShield serves over 10,000 government, enterprise, military, and state-owned entities, making it an indispensable foundational platform for the construction of smart institutions and providing robust support for various AI intelligent applications.

title_i18n.zh: 将 hf CLI 设计为一种面向代理优化的方式与 Hub 交互
title_i18n.es: Diseñar la CLI de hf como una forma optimizada para agentes de trabajar con el Hub.

excerpt_i18n.en: Hugging Face introduces the hf CLI, an agent-optimized command-line tool for streamlined interaction with the Hub, supporting datasets, models, and Spaces operations.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Hugging Face 推出了专为 AI 代理优化的 hf CLI 工具，旨在简化与 Hub 的交互。该命令行界面支持高效的数据集、模型和空间操作，并集成代理工作流。
